meta.title: Financial Health Review
meta.data_note: Synthetic design fixture only — no real account, policy or market data. Never reuse these figures in a report.

cover.headline: This synthetic household has a modelled term-cover shortfall. Review the protection assumptions before changing investments; the generic fund and retirement buckets do not establish total equity exposure.

coverage.lede: Every spoke sees one domain; this is the only view that sees all of them and how they interact. It builds the net-worth spine across the classes no spoke touches — property, gold, EPF, FDs — then weighs investments, protection and cashflow together to answer one question: where does the next rupee go?

spine.title: Illustrative asset mix and accessible reserve
spine.lede: Synthetic asset values reconcile to ₹1.85 Cr with confirmed zero liabilities. Direct Indian/US equity is 42% of gross assets; fund and retirement composition remain unresolved. The sample accessible reserve is explicitly confirmed separately.

cards.label: HOLDINGS XIRR
cards.sub: descriptive holding mean; not portfolio XIRR

legs.title: Each leg's one-line verdict
legs.lede: Synthetic domain assessments illustrate the reporting structure. These conclusions are not based on live tools.
legs.footer: Digests only — full leg reports at artifacts/wealth/2026-08-28.md/legs/

items.name: Investments
items.read: No concentration or exit flags in the complete synthetic digest. The 14.2% holding-XIRR mean is descriptive, not portfolio return.

items.name: Protection
items.read: The supplied hypothetical need is ₹2.4 Cr and held term cover ₹50 L, leaving ₹1.9 Cr to review. This need is a stated scenario, not an automatic income multiple. Health adequacy requires its own assessment.

items.name: Cashflow
items.read: Synthetic complete cashflow reports a 28% savings rate. No claim about future spending or investment capacity follows from this alone.

scorecard.title: The assessed domains and their limits
scorecard.lede: Five domains, each a falsifiable one-liner. The overall grade is the worst assessed domain — because a critical protection gap is not averaged away by strong investments.
scorecard.footer: Status ∈ strong · adequate · weak · critical · not assessed · overall = worst assessed domain

rows.read: Asset totals reconcile in this fixture; total equity exposure remains unresolved.
No concentration or exit flags in the supplied complete synthetic investment digest.
Term cover is short under the supplied scenario; validate need assumptions and health evidence.
28% savings rate in the complete synthetic cashflow period.
3.1 assessed months falls within the engine’s 3–6-month convention.

cross.title: The calls no single spoke can make
cross.lede: This is where the whole-picture view earns its place. Each of these reads needs two domains at once — and each overrules the instinct a single spoke would have.
cross.footer: risk_posture is the personal balance-sheet posture — never loosened by a risk-on market

ef.label: EMERGENCY-FUND RUNWAY
ef.note: Synthetic confirmed accessible reserve ₹3.7 L, dated 2026-08-28, divided by stated monthly expenses ₹1.2 L gives about 3.1 months. Asset labels alone would not establish reserve availability.

reads.label: PROTECTION VS NET WORTH
reads.text: On the earner's death the family faces a ₹1.9 Cr shortfall against its needs — the single biggest risk on this balance sheet, and it dwarfs any fund-selection or entry-timing decision.

reads.label: RISK POSTURE
reads.text: Total equity exposure is unknown without underlying fund/retirement composition. No age-based target or permission to add risk is inferred.

plan.title: Prioritized review steps
plan.lede: Review the evidence before executing any allocation or insurance change.
plan.footer: Each action names the spoke to run for depth · max five, most-important first

rows.step: Reconcile liabilities, dependents, existing cover and the supplied scenario.
Obtain sourced fund composition and compare with the stated allocation plan.

gaps.title: What this review does not cover
gaps.lede: All numbers in this design fixture are synthetic. Real reports retain source dates, coverage and unresolved evidence.

items.label: LEG DEPTH DEFERRED
items.text: Each leg ran in cheap mode — the deep portfolio, insurance and budget analyses live in the named spokes. Run them for the full working.

items.label: PROTECTION NEED IS A MODEL
items.text: The sample term need is an explicit hypothetical scenario. Real need must be calculated from sourced facts and labelled assumptions.

items.label: PROPERTY VALUATION
items.text: Real estate is carried at the IndMoney-supplied value — an estimate, not a transacted price; a 20% swing there moves the allocation percentages.

items.label: ILLUSTRATIVE SAMPLE
items.text: This deck is a design specimen with sample figures. A real run carries your own IndMoney net worth and live leg digests.

gaps.weakest: Unresolved assumptions require review; this specimen makes no recommendation for a real household.
gaps.disclaimer: Synthetic design specimen. Not investment advice — personal research tool.
